tidbit: Did you know… about 15,000 new articles reached our newsroom in the last 24 hours.
transcript:
Hourly brief, Founders' Preview. Here is what is moving in superintelligence (SI), the next generation of artificial intelligence (AI).
Oxus Metals AI has raised 36 million dollars to use artificial intelligence in mineral exploration across Central Asia and beyond, confirmed by 巴士的報.
Nvidia has launched RTX Spark laptops with local artificial intelligence and 128GB memory at 2,399 dollars, reported by IT Brief UK.
Google's Chrome now suggests email information for forms using Gemini-powered autofill, reported by TechRepublic.
According to OpenAI CEO Sam Altman, it's quite terrible for people to have RAM in their own computers, confirmed by IGN. Altman links artificial intelligence demand to rising consumer hardware prices.
INSEAD has launched an artificial intelligence-focused research lab with 3 million dollars from Google, reported by PR Newswire. The lab aims to advance human well-being in the age of artificial intelligence.
Free every hour.
